TileToGeneratePg1.name: Generate Map16 tiles: page 1 and wings block
summary: Block generation (tile generated by a sprite or block action, block number in [$9C]). The first routine handles blocks $09-$17: it
looks up the Map16 tile number in the table, writes it into the level Map16 map at ([$6B]),Y / ([$6E],Y bit 0 = page 1) and queues a
stripe image update for the 16x16 block when the block is inside the visible area ([$08]/[$0C] horizontal, [$0A]/[$0E] vertical).
The tail at $00C0FB is shared with the page 0 routine. Records are appended to the buffer at $7F:837D (write index $7F:837B).
$00C1AC: block $18 (invisible block containing wings): sets this block and the one below to Map16 tile $25 and queues vertical records.

FlippedGateBgTiles?.name: Cage tile data and cage/empty block generation
summary: $00C29E: two 6x6-tile cage graphics (blocks $19 and $1A), as tile and property bytes. $00C32E: 3-byte pointers to them.
$00C334: generates a cage: queues six horizontal 6-tile records starting one tile down and right of the block.
$00C3D1 (block $1B): sets a 2x2 block area to Map16 tile $25 and queues four RLE records filling 4x4 tiles with tile $F8, palette 6.

s00C470.name: Tables: keyhole window animation
summary: Per keyhole phase [$1435]: target circle size ($90/$00), size step per frame (+4/-4) and WOBJSEL value ($30/$33).

s00C47E.name: Per-frame Mario state: keyhole, timers, animation
summary: Called every frame from the Mario/sprite interaction code. Runs the keyhole closing animation (circle HDMA window around the keyhole,
freezes Mario and sprites, secret exit when done), counts down the timers $1496-$14A8 each frame and $14A9-$14AE every 4th frame,
switches music for the bonus game and the P-switch timers, then runs the current Mario animation ([$71]). Select drops the item box item.
$00C593: runs the Mario animation routine from AnimationSeqPtr.

AnimationSeqPtr.name: Pointer table: Mario animation routines
summary: Indexed by [$71] (Mario animation number), used with ExecutePtr.

UnknownAniB.name: Mario animation B: freeze with message box
summary: Clears [$13DE]/[$13ED]. If the end-of-level timer is set outside a level, leaves the level; otherwise shows an expanding message box
([$1B88] = 1), clears the controls and runs Mario's physics.

s00C5E1.name: Data: cutscene poses and Mario movement scripts
summary: $00C5E1: Mario pose numbers. $00C5E8 on: scripts for UnknownAniC, one per cutscene [$13C6] = 1-7, each a list of (command, frames) pairs ending
in command $FF. A command without bit 5 is a controller byte; with bit 5 it is a special action. Bit 4 also runs a bank $0C helper.

s00C6DF.name: Table: cutscene script offsets
summary: Offset added to [$8F] to find the script of cutscene [$13C6] (cutscenes 1-7 use entries 1-7).

UnknownAniC.name: Mario animation C: scripted cutscene movement
summary: Plays a script from the table at $00C5E8 for cutscene [$13C6]: held buttons or special actions per command. Also lands Mario at Y = $58 and
makes scripted hops. Purpose partly unclear (probably the post-castle cutscenes).

YoshiWingsAni.name: Mario animation 8: Yoshi wings exit
summary: Mario flies up (Y speed -$0D per frame up to -$70) while X speed decays to 0. When he passes the threshold in DATA_00C7F9[[$1B95]] the
level reloads (phase 0, sets [$1B95] = 2) or normal control resumes (phase 2).
